# /crav1-merge-pr

lane: cross-cutting | group: Commit and pull request | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 0
purpose: Merge one named pull request with a merge commit.
use_when: This turn asks to merge a named pull request
reads: Reads one named pull request, and the merge-readiness line of its PR record in the specs repo.
writes: Writes a merge commit on the host, and fast-forwards local default when the tree is clean after a confirmed two-parent merge. Then writes or reuses the PR note in the specs repo's `docs/notes/YYYY-MM/`, with its PR record's `State` and `Ready` lines set to merged (not committed).
leaves alone: Leaves squash, rebase, branch deletion, and work-item links alone.
limits: a required red host check stops it, and so does a PR record whose `Ready` line says no, unless the turn says `anyway`. It does not run `/crav1-review-pr` or `/crav1-pr-status`.
flow:
- advice to merge the base in settles pristine kit copies with `kit_merge.py settle` and commits that merge with `kit_merge.py commit` (`git commit --no-edit --cleanup=strip`), as `/crav1-finalize-commit` `references/pull.md` says.
- a bare number is resolved from the kit's records before this checkout's remote (`pr_common.py resolve`); several candidates are asked, never picked.
- Only the resolved host's CLI is named, and the ending is Run next, never a `Next:` line.
- the build walk's merge card names the pull request, for example `Merge PR 71 into develop?`, as the card wording rule in `docs/reference/question-cards.md` says.
- the shared pull-request steps are `crav1-docs/reference/pr-common.md` and `scripts/pr_common.py`.
- The merge rules are unchanged: the explicit merge ask, the merge commit (`gh pr merge --merge`, Azure Repos `--squash false`), never squash, rebase or bypass, the PR record gate and `anyway`, and the walk printing its own Run next.
- It never writes or clears `claims.md`; `/crav1-build-walk` clears its own claim after the merge.
- The GitHub host and read steps moved word for word to `references/github.md`, the Azure DevOps ready step to `references/azure-devops.md`.
- Merge one named pull request only when that turn asks; always a merge commit; no squash, rebase, or policy bypass.
- After the completed re-read, two parents are confirmed with `git rev-list` (commits API if git cannot see the commit).
- Does not run `/crav1-review-pr`.
- after a confirmed merge, says `<n> of <m> branches of <slug> now merged into <target>` per spec.
- a branch that is behind the base or has conflicts gets one line: merge the base into the branch, push, then ask to merge again.
- Never a rebase.
- if that merge leaves `walk-progress.md` conflicted only on version lines, run `resolve-stamps` as `/crav1-finalize-commit` `references/pull.md` says.
- a yes on `/crav1-build-walk`'s card that names this pull request is the ask.
- after a sub-branch merge, says `<n> of <m> sub-branches merged into <spec branch>` and any `left behind` branch; a reverted branch shows `merged, reverted on <base> (<sha>)`, report only.
- the `Promotion:` line after the after-merge line, with the optional `pipeline-runs` check.
- before the merge it reads the merge-readiness line (`Ready:`) of the PR note's shared PR record.
- `Ready: no` stops the merge and lists the reasons, unless the turn says `anyway`; `anyway` never skips a required check, policy or review.
- No line: it goes on and names `/crav1-pr-status`.
- After the merge it sets `State: merged` and `Ready: merged` in the record instead of a `State on <date>` line.

## Choice words
- question: Also check the latest pipeline runs?
  - `pipeline-runs`: check the latest successful Azure DevOps runs behind the Promotion line (read-only)
- question: The PR record says not ready
  - `anyway`: merge although the record's `Ready:` line says no; host checks, policies and reviews still apply
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: /crav1-refresh-system-notes after an outside pull request merges; /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-merge-pr <pull request number or URL> Merge this pull request.`
walkthrough: from-commit.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.211.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-merge-pr.md
